crossRefs.note: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one…
A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.
You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal…
Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.

translations.web: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
translations.bsb: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
translations.kjv: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
